topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Suppressing 19th harmonics reduces intermodulation products (IMD) and adjacent channel interference (ACI), but increases filtering complexity. In dense payload configurations, this trade-off affects transponder power efficiency. The added filtering requirements reduce amplifier efficiency, increasing equivalent 'cost' per bit due to reduced transmission rate and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Higher noise figures compromise transponder capacity due to reduced SNR, limiting transmission rates and increasing equivalent cost per bit.
